Software Architecture
Spring 2027 · days, time and room TBD · Dr. Marcel Gavriliudraft
📜Syllabus🗓️Schedule📚Course textsoon🏗️Projectsoon🐳Platformsoon🎤Paperssoon

Concepts, representations, methods and tools for structuring software systems. The class inherits a running distributed system, recovers its architecture, and designs and builds its next version.

Weeks click a week to open it; the current week opens by itself
